Thanks for sending — I reviewed the W-9 and bank letter. A couple of follow-ups before we finalize the master record:

1) Legal entity confirmation: please confirm the exact payee name to be used on payments. If Pegasus Systems, Inc. is the legal payee, we’re good; if payment should go to a parent/subsidiary, we need that documented.

2) Remit address vs Registered address: if invoices should be sent to a different remit address or a billing email, state that explicitly. For automated PO routing we prefer a dedicated invoices@ or ap@ inbox.

3) ACH verification: bank letter is acceptable, but for higher $ amounts we require a bank letter dated within the last 90 days AND either a voided check or ACH enrollment form. You can redact account balances.

4) Tax residency: confirm US tax residency & whether you have any foreign subsidiaries that invoice us from non-US entities.

5) Payment terms: please confirm standard terms (net30 is our default for new vendors). If you request alternative terms, state reason and approval contact.

If you can reply with the five items above, we’ll complete the vendor profile. I’ve added a link to our vendor intake form (optional) if you prefer to fill fields directly: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOnboardingForms
